base_observation: The admitted VSR07 pre-fix discriminator proves that a fully unrelated valid MemoryLifecycleState can be accepted. A superficial repair could still compare only payload_ref or only payload_sha256. Exact heard-result memory identity requires the pair to bind the same exact heard-result payload.

falsifiers.setup: Use a valid completed HeardResultPayload. Build a valid MemoryLifecycleState whose payload_ref equals the exact heard_result.payload_ref but whose payload_sha256 is a different valid lowercase 64-hex digest; bind a valid TypedMemoryRecord to that lifecycle state and reference its memory_id from memory_event.
falsifiers.failure_signature: The consumer accepts memory evidence because payload_ref matches while lifecycle payload_sha256 does not equal the exact heard-result payload_sha256.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Rejects a reference-only partial fix and proves that the digest half of payload identity remains causal/identity-bearing.

falsifiers.setup: Use a valid completed HeardResultPayload. Build a valid MemoryLifecycleState whose payload_sha256 equals the exact heard_result.payload_sha256 but whose payload_ref is a different valid non-empty reference; bind a valid TypedMemoryRecord to that lifecycle state and reference its memory_id from memory_event.
falsifiers.failure_signature: The consumer accepts memory evidence because payload_sha256 matches while lifecycle payload_ref does not equal the exact heard-result payload_ref.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Rejects a digest-only partial fix and proves that the canonical payload reference half of identity remains bound too.

acceptance_guidance: The G3 consumer-side repair should require lifecycle.payload_ref == heard_result.payload_ref AND lifecycle.payload_sha256 == heard_result.payload_sha256 before exact heard-result memory evidence is admitted. Typed-memory validity remains necessary but cannot substitute for either relation. Preserve existing memory authority and do not introduce a second memory state or truth authority.
next_exact_action: G3 mutation owner consumes VSR07C/VSR07D after refreshing main, adds them as adversarial regressions if not already covered, and rejects both one-field-only matches before repository acceptance. Do not dispatch VPS until the materially changed exact subject passes the full WP717 repository discriminator set.
